narrative_prose: Hector squinted against the blinding Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea, feeling the intense vibration of the metallic waves vibrating in his chest. The heavy smell of electrified ozone saturated the humid air, while the screeching of twisted alloy deafened him as he gripped the railing. A bitter taste of copper coated his mouth as the intense light from the storm illuminated the desolate, churning sea. Desperately trying to CONCEAL the critical core drive from the swirling magnetic currents, he moved quickly to ATTRACT Kaio's attention, preparing to toss the brass baton. With the raging forces threatening to CONSUME their footing, Hector braced himself and successfully executed the baton handoff.
summary: Hector struggles through a violent magnetohydrodynamic shear storm over the ferrofluid sea to pass the baton to Kaio.
